summary.ja: 保存則の各界面を局所Riemann問題として扱う有限体積の基準法。公開例は区分一定の空間再構成に近似流束とSSPRK3を組み合わせ、Sod問題で高次法との差を比較する。
summary.en: A finite-volume baseline using a local Riemann problem at each interface. The released example combines piecewise-constant spatial reconstruction, an approximate flux and SSPRK3, enabling comparison with higher-order solvers on Sod's problem.

code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Godunov (1959). A difference method for numerical calculation of discontinuous solutions of the equations of hydrodynamics.
references.scope: Original Godunov-method source. It is not evidence that the local SSPRK3/approximate-flux implementation reproduces the original fully discrete algorithm.

supports.ja: Godunov法の原報。今回確認したのは原誌の書誌であり、局所実装の時間積分・近似流束を原報と同一とは扱わない。
supports.en: Original paper for the Godunov method; its journal record was checked. The atlas uses a separately specified time integrator and approximate flux.

verification.locator: Journal archive bibliographic record; Russian full text not reviewed.

references.label: Shu & Osher (1988). Efficient implementation of essentially non-oscillatory shock-capturing schemes.
references.scope: Primary source for TVD Runge–Kutta time discretization and flux-based ENO construction; the local SSPRK(3,3) coefficients are independently visible in code.

supports.ja: 流束ベースの構成とTVD Runge–Kutta時間離散化に関する一次文献。ここで用いる3段3次の係数は公開コードで確認した。
supports.en: Primary source for TVD Runge–Kutta time discretization and flux-based construction. The atlas three-stage third-order coefficients were checked in code.

verification.locator: Publisher-indexed abstract and bibliographic record; full tableau not reviewed.

references.label: Toro, Spruce & Speares (1994). Restoration of the contact surface in the HLL-Riemann solver.
references.scope: Original HLLC contact-restoration source; no claim that all wave-speed estimates or WAF experiments in the paper are implemented.

supports.ja: HLL近似解へ接触波を復元する考え方の原報。論文中の各波速推定やWAF計算をすべて再現したという意味ではない。
supports.en: Primary source for restoring the contact wave missing from HLL. Its complete wave-speed alternatives and WAF experiments were not audited.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record; full text not reviewed.

references.label: Sod (1978). A survey of several finite difference methods for systems of nonlinear hyperbolic conservation laws.
references.scope: Historical shock-tube comparison used as a benchmark source. The atlas reference is its own non-vacuum ideal-gas Riemann evaluator, with a bracketed numerical pressure solve.

supports.ja: Sod衝撃波管という比較課題の出典。参照値は本サイトの非真空・理想気体Riemann解評価器で求め、論文表を転記した値とは区別する。
supports.en: Benchmark provenance for the Sod shock tube. Atlas reference values come from its non-vacuum ideal-gas Riemann evaluator, rather than transcribed paper tables.

verification.locator: Publisher-indexed abstract and bibliographic record; detailed initial-state tables not reviewed.

assumptions: The scope is one-dimensional hyperbolic conservation laws on a uniform Cartesian grid with a model-compatible numerical flux.
Euler assumes a perfect gas and positive density/pressure; HLLC and other Euler fluxes are available. Shallow-water and isothermal models require HLL or Rusanov in this solver.
solve(...,method='godunov') sets reconstruction slopes to zero and advances with SSPRK(3,3). Initial data are sampled at grid locations and used as cell values.
The released solver requires 0<CFL≤0.5; this bound alone is not a positivity guarantee for arbitrary inputs.
units: Use units consistent with each model's conserved variables and fluxes. Euler uses density ρ, momentum density ρu and total energy density E; each flux has its conserved-variable unit times length/time. Released shock tubes are nondimensional.
boundary_conditions: The released _pad supplies periodic ghosts, fixed initial endpoint states, or edge extrapolation. Extrapolation is not an exact nonreflecting condition; reflecting walls and general inflow conditions are not implemented. Boundary fluxes contribute to global balances on nonperiodic domains.

limitations.ja: 空間1次なので衝撃波や接触面が広がる。原報の厳密Riemann解を用いる1段更新そのものではなく、時間3次でも全体の空間精度は1次のまま。近似流束・初期値の点サンプル・境界処理の選択に依存し、真空、乾湿境界、一般EOS、多次元および一般的な正値性・エントロピー保証は対象外。
limitations.en: First-order spatial reconstruction smears shocks and contacts. This is not the original one-step exact-Riemann algorithm, and third-order time stepping does not raise its spatial order. Results depend on the approximate flux, sampled initialization and boundary treatment. Vacuum, wet/dry fronts, general equations of state, multiple dimensions, and general positivity/entropy guarantees are outside scope.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source-and-code inspection; no numerical rerun; reference access recorded individually

assumptions_ja: 対象は1次元・一様Cartesian格子上の双曲型保存則で、各方程式に整合する流束を選ぶ。
Eulerでは理想気体、正の密度・圧力を前提とし、HLLC等を選べる。浅水・等温モデルにはHLLまたはRusanovを選ぶ。
公開solve(...,method='godunov')は傾きを0にし、SSPRK(3,3)で時間積分する。初期値は格子点でのサンプルをセル値として与える。
公開solverが受け付けるCFLは0<CFL≤0.5。この上限だけで任意の入力の正値性を保証するものではない。
units_ja: 方程式ごとの保存変数と流束に一貫した単位を使う。Eulerでは密度ρ、運動量密度ρu、全エネルギー密度Eで、流束の単位は各保存量×長さ/時間。公開衝撃波管は無次元。
boundary_conditions_ja: 公開_padは周期、端点初期値固定、または端値の外挿でゴースト値を作る。外挿は厳密な無反射条件ではなく、反射壁や一般の流入条件は実装していない。非周期領域の総量変化には境界流束が入る。

problem.ja: 圧縮性流体など、衝撃波を含む1次元保存則の時間発展。
problem.en: Time evolution of one-dimensional conservation laws, including shocks in compressible flow.

variant.ja: solvers.solveのmethod='godunov': 区分一定状態＋選択した近似Riemann流束＋SSPRK(3,3)。既定Euler流束はHLLC。
variant.en: method='godunov' in solvers.solve: piecewise-constant states, a selected approximate Riemann flux and SSPRK(3,3). HLLC is the default Euler flux.

ja: 高次再構成の効果を測る、保守的な空間1次の比較基準が欲しい。
実装範囲内の1次元モデルで、波速に応じた時間刻みを選べる。
en: A conservative first-order spatial baseline is needed to measure the effect of higher-order reconstruction.
A supported one-dimensional model can be stepped according to its wave speeds.

ja: 接触面や滑らかな波を少ないセルで高精度に保ちたい。
真空・乾燥・複雑な境界を、この基準solverだけで保証付きに扱いたい。
en: Contacts or smooth waves must remain highly accurate on a coarse mesh.
Vacuum, dry states or complex boundaries require guarantees absent from this baseline solver.

reason.ja: solveの再構成分岐、対応モデル、CFL検査を確認。
reason.en: Inspected reconstruction branches, model restrictions and CFL checks in solve.

reason.ja: equations.pyの保存変数・物理流束で定義。
reason.en: Specified from conserved variables and physical fluxes in equations.py.

reason.ja: 空間再構成と時間積分を分け、原法との差を明記。
reason.en: Distinguishes spatial reconstruction, time integration and the historical algorithm.

summary.ja: solvers.pyのsolve・rk3・_pad、equations.pyのEuler/Barotropic、riemann.pyの近似流束とexact_eulerを読んだ。test_sod_accuracy_and_refinementのgodunov分岐と参照Riemann値のテストを確認。実行や原論文の数値表の再現はしていない。
summary.en: Read solve, rk3 and _pad in solvers.py, Euler/Barotropic in equations.py, and the approximate-flux and exact_euler functions in riemann.py. Inspected the Godunov branch of test_sod_accuracy_and_refinement and reference-Riemann tests. No tests were rerun and no paper tables reproduced.

ja: Godunov原報のロシア語本文、原法との逐式比較。
新しい再実行、全流束・全モデルでの収束証明、真空・乾湿境界。
en: Russian full text and equation-by-equation comparison with the original Godunov method.
New numerical runs, convergence proofs for every flux/model combination, vacuum or wet/dry fronts.

title.ja: SWASHES地形流：静水と非零流量の定常解
title.en: SWASHES topographic flow: lakes and nonzero steady discharge

summary.ja: 水没・露出した隆起上の静水と、非零流量の亜臨界定常解を別々に検査します。静水の保存と、動く定常流に残る離散化誤差を区別します。
summary.en: Check two lake equilibria separately from nonzero subcritical flow, distinguishing lake preservation from moving-flow discretization error.

assumptions.ja: 1次元、g=9.81、長さ25m、8<x<12でz=.2−.05(x−10)²m。水位.5/.1mの静水は200セル、流量4.42m²/s・下流深さ2mの定常流は100/200/400セル、t=2s。地形は区分定数セル平均。定常流から開始し、静水からの定常化実験とは区別します。
assumptions.en: 1D, g=9.81, L=25m, compact parabolic bed z=.2-.05(x-10)^2 on8<x<12. Lakes at surface .5/.1m use200 cells. Moving flow q=4.42m2/s, downstream h=2m uses100/200/400 cells to2s. Initialize the steady branch, not the published rest-to-steady transient.

algorithm.ja: 非負な静水圧再構成、共有HLL流束と左右の圧力補正で地形源項を離散化します。前進Euler、面Courant数.4。静水は反射壁。亜臨界流は上流で流量・下流で水深のみを指定し他変数を外挿します。floor・clip・retryはありません。 HLL更新を非負の水量packetに代数的に分解し、丸め後の同じ水量から移流運動量を作ります。微小水深閾値や事後修復は使いません。
algorithm.en: Hydrostatic reconstruction, shared HLL flux and left/right pressure corrections discretize the bed source; forward Euler and face CFL .4. Lakes use reflecting walls. Moving subcritical boundaries impose upstream q and downstream h, extrapolating the other datum. No state floors, clipping or retries. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair.

validation.ja: 31単体検査と8固定計算を事前固定。静水の水深・流量の最大変化、全FE段の非負水深、共有流束と地形運動量の収支、定常流3格子の保存量セル平均L1誤差・細分化比を保存します。独立したBernoulli二分法のエネルギー一定・亜臨界枝を照合します。
validation.en: Freeze31 unit checks and eight group runs. Record lake drift, every FE minimum depth, shared-flux/bed-impulse budgets, conservative-mean L1 errors and three-grid ratios. Qualify an independent Bernoulli bisection by energy and branch checks.

limits.ja: 静水の厳密釣合いは表現したセル地形に対する性質です。非零流量の定常解は厳密には保存されず、有限時刻の誤差を測ります。遷移流・跳水・摩擦・降雨・浸透・2次元流や完全離散エントロピー安定性は検証しません。
limits.en: Exact lake balance concerns the represented cell bed. Moving steady states retain finite-time numerical error. Transcritical flows, jumps, friction, rain, infiltration, 2D flow and fully discrete entropy stability are outside scope.

caption.ja: 保存した有限体積配列から描いた地形・水面と定常誤差のプレビュー。
caption.en: Preview of represented bed, saved FV surfaces and moving-steady errors.

title.ja: 乾いた河床のダム破壊：実際のwetting/drying
title.en: Dry-bed dam break: actual wetting and dry states

summary.ja: 右半分を厳密にh=q=0として開始する浅水方程式を解き、実際の乾湿前線の進行と保存をRitter解析解と比較します。
summary.en: Start the right half at exactly h=q=0 and compare wetting-front advance, conservation and conservative errors with the Ritter analytic solution.

assumptions.ja: 平坦床・無摩擦、[−10,10]m、ダムx=0、左深さ1m・右0m、初速0、g=9.81、t=.5s、1600/3200/6400セル。SWASHESのRitter式を明示した別スケールで使い、原例の.005m・6s入力とは区別します。
assumptions.en: Flat frictionless bed on[-10,10]m, dam0, hL=1m/hR=0, initial velocity0, g=9.81, t=.5s,1600/3200/6400 cells. The Ritter formula uses an explicit rescaling distinct from the paper numerical example.

algorithm.ja: 同じ有限体積ソルバーが乾状態h=q=0を直接扱います。片側乾床HLL波速はu−c,u+2c（反対向きも同様）。面Courant数.4で前進Euler更新し、状態の切上げなしに全更新後の非負性と共有流束収支を記録します。 HLL更新を非負の水量packetに代数的に分解し、丸め後の同じ水量から移流運動量を作ります。微小水深閾値や事後修復は使いません。
algorithm.en: The FV solver supports h=q=0 directly; one-sided dry HLL speeds use u-c/u+2c and their reflection. Forward Euler at face CFL .4 records every minimum and shared-flux budget without raising cell depths. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair.

validation.ja: 全段の水深min、新たに濡れた初期乾セル数、残る乾セル数、境界流束を含む質量・運動量収支を保存します。Ritterのhとhuをファン端で分割したGauss8セル平均と比較し、Gauss16・全質量・PDE残差で参照を確認。3格子L1細分化とh≥.001mの最右セル中心を検査します。 水深L1の合否は初回と同じ固定参照質量5m²で正規化し、領域を広げたことによる基準の緩和を防ぎます。領域全体の相対L1は別の診断です。
validation.en: Record all FE minima, newly wetted and remaining dry cells, boundary-aware mass/momentum budgets, and L1 refinement. Split Gauss8 h/hu references are qualified by Gauss16, mass and PDE identities. Diagnose the rightmost cell center with mean h>=.001m. Depth acceptance uses the original fixed5m2 reference mass, preventing domain extension from weakening the criterion; full-domain relativeL1 remains a separate diagnostic.

limits.ja: 前線診断はセル平均の.001m等深線で、厳密な支持端を別に保存します。非負性は固定実行の実測です。初期乾セルの濡れを検査し、後退汀線・周期的な再乾燥、実地洪水、摩擦や地形上の移動前線は検証しません。 初回100/200/400セル・[−5,5]mでは28検査と105/109判定が合格し、乾セル残存3判定と前線誤差.3960>.25mが不合格でした。元の全記録を保持し、許容条件を変えず領域・格子を細分化しました。 領域・格子だけを変えた第2回は微小な裾のbinary64 underflowで停止しました。第3回は同じHLL更新の水量packetによる代数的評価を導入し、元の28検査に3検査を追加します。 第3回は108/109判定が合格し、最細の前線誤差.27415>.25mで不合格でした。第4回は同じ領域のRitter格子だけを1600/3200/6400に細分化します。相対水深L1は領域内参照質量で正規化し、領域変更を比べるため絶対L1も保存します。
limits.en: The .001m mean-depth contour differs from the analytic support edge, which is reported separately. These fixed runs test wetting of initially dry cells. Retreating shorelines, re-drying cycles, real floods, friction and moving fronts over topography are outside scope. The initial100/200/400-cell [-5,5]m attempt passed28 tests and105/109 gates; three retained-dry-cell gates and the .3960m>.25m contour error failed. All original records remain archived; revision2 enlarges/refines the input without changing acceptance. Revision2 then stopped on a binary64 subnormal-tail dry-momentum artifact. Revision3 factors the same HLL update into water packets and adds three regression/equivalence tests; the original28 remain unchanged. Revision3 passed108/109 gates but failed the .27415m>.25m contour criterion. Revision4 refines only Ritter grids to1600/3200/6400. Relative depth L1 is normalized by domain reference mass; absolute L1 is also retained because the domain changed between revisions1 and2.

name.ja: SWASHES地形流：静水と非零流量の定常解
name.en: SWASHES topographic flow: lakes and nonzero steady discharge

scope.ja: 水没・露出した隆起上の静水と、非零流量の亜臨界定常解を別々に検査します。静水の保存と、動く定常流に残る離散化誤差を区別します。
scope.en: Check two lake equilibria separately from nonzero subcritical flow, distinguishing lake preservation from moving-flow discretization error.

method_note.ja: 非負な静水圧再構成、共有HLL流束と左右の圧力補正で地形源項を離散化します。前進Euler、面Courant数.4。静水は反射壁。亜臨界流は上流で流量・下流で水深のみを指定し他変数を外挿します。floor・clip・retryはありません。 HLL更新を非負の水量packetに代数的に分解し、丸め後の同じ水量から移流運動量を作ります。微小水深閾値や事後修復は使いません。
method_note.en: Hydrostatic reconstruction, shared HLL flux and left/right pressure corrections discretize the bed source; forward Euler and face CFL .4. Lakes use reflecting walls. Moving subcritical boundaries impose upstream q and downstream h, extrapolating the other datum. No state floors, clipping or retries. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair.

method_note.ja: 同じ有限体積ソルバーが乾状態h=q=0を直接扱います。片側乾床HLL波速はu−c,u+2c（反対向きも同様）。面Courant数.4で前進Euler更新し、状態の切上げなしに全更新後の非負性と共有流束収支を記録します。 HLL更新を非負の水量packetに代数的に分解し、丸め後の同じ水量から移流運動量を作ります。微小水深閾値や事後修復は使いません。
method_note.en: The FV solver supports h=q=0 directly; one-sided dry HLL speeds use u-c/u+2c and their reflection. Forward Euler at face CFL .4 records every minimum and shared-flux budget without raising cell depths. Algebraically factor HLL updates into nonnegative water packets; advected momentum uses those same rounded masses, without a small-depth threshold or subsequent repair.

title.ja: Ritter乾燥床破堤：g9.81の専用セル平均参照
title.en: Ritter dry-bed dam break: dedicated g9.81 cell-mean reference

note.ja: 前線診断はセル平均の.001m等深線で、厳密な支持端を別に保存します。非負性は固定実行の実測です。初期乾セルの濡れを検査し、後退汀線・周期的な再乾燥、実地洪水、摩擦や地形上の移動前線は検証しません。 初回100/200/400セル・[−5,5]mでは28検査と105/109判定が合格し、乾セル残存3判定と前線誤差.3960>.25mが不合格でした。元の全記録を保持し、許容条件を変えず領域・格子を細分化しました。 領域・格子だけを変えた第2回は微小な裾のbinary64 underflowで停止しました。第3回は同じHLL更新の水量packetによる代数的評価を導入し、元の28検査に3検査を追加します。
note.en: The .001m mean-depth contour differs from the analytic support edge, which is reported separately. These fixed runs test wetting of initially dry cells. Retreating shorelines, re-drying cycles, real floods, friction and moving fronts over topography are outside scope. The initial100/200/400-cell [-5,5]m attempt passed28 tests and105/109 gates; three retained-dry-cell gates and the .3960m>.25m contour error failed. All original records remain archived; revision2 enlarges/refines the input without changing acceptance. Revision2 then stopped on a binary64 subnormal-tail dry-momentum artifact. Revision3 factors the same HLL update into water packets and adds three regression/equivalence tests; the original28 remain unchanged.

note.ja: 既存の乾燥床浅水参照は元の重力・領域・時刻を保持します。今回のg9.81・[-10,10]・t.5は専用Ritter参照で照合します。
note.en: Retain the historical dry-bed reference gravity/domain/time unchanged. The new g9.81,[-10,10],t.5 computation uses its dedicated Ritter reference.
